description: Port City Economic Commission - The Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021 Amana Takaful Life PLC
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory notice from the Colombo Port City Economic Commission regarding the intended cancellation of a license and removal from the register of authorized persons under specific regulations (Regulations for Registration, Licensing, Authorisation and other Approvals of Authorised Persons No. 01 of 2022). It involves regulatory compliance requirements and statutory procedures for license cancellation, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure or other specialized categories.
